sources.title: GitHub - Xinyi-0724/Search-R1-Qwen3: Enhanced Search-R1 Implementation ...
sources.snippet: The original Search-R1 framework, built upon veRL, extends the ideas of DeepSeek-R1 (-Zero) by incorporating interleaved search engine access and provides a fully open-source RL training pipeline. It serves as an alternative and open solution to OpenAI DeepResearch, enabling research and development in tool-augmented LLM reasoning.

sources.title: wckwan/Search-R1-Qwen3-8B-Process-GRPO-PerTurnNorm · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A Qwen/Qwen3-8B policy trained as a multi-turn search agent (Search-R1 style) with Process-GRPO: a process reward model (Olmo-3-7B-Think verifier) scores each turn, with per- (group, turn-position) advantage normalization and verifier prompts that include the retrieved tool responses and the gold answer.
